name: luminous-quartz-sheen12-rest-damage
notes: Engine bug, FIXED: customDQHandlers["40lgjj1yS3:0:ActivateAbility-1"] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php ~line 27053) called RemoveCounters($player, $champMZ, "preparation", 1) but never assigned $champMZ anywhere in that handler's own scope -- $champMZ was only computed locally inside the sibling $activateAbilityAbilities["40lgjj1yS3:0"] body and the $activateAbilityPrereqs["40lgjj1yS3:0"] prereq closure (two separate closures), so this handler hit a genuine 'Undefined variable $champMZ' PHP warning and called RemoveCounters() with $champMZ === null, which silently no-ops -- the REST cost was paid correctly but the 'Remove a preparation counter from your champion' cost never was, even though the activation prereq (activateAbilityPrereqs["40lgjj1yS3:0"]) already correctly gated on the champion having >=1 preparation counter via its own FindChampionMZ($player) call -- that gate was never broken, only the actual removal in this handler. Fixed via an override of the same dispatch key in GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php that computes $champMZ with FindChampionMZ($player) (Custom/CardDQHandlers.php, the established 'my own champion's mzID' helper) before calling RemoveCounters(); the damage-dealing body is otherwise untouched. Fixture updated to seed the champion with a preparation counter (setup patchMzId myField-0) and assert it drops to zero (Counters == '[]') after activation, in addition to the pre-existing REST-status and 1+X-damage assertions. Break/restore verified: temporarily reverting to the bugged RemoveCounters($player, $champMZ, ...) call (no $champMZ assignment) makes the fixture fail specifically on the new Counters assertion ('Expected myField-0.Counters to equal [], got {"preparation":1}'); restoring the fix passes again.

rulesClauses: [Sheen 12+] REST, Remove a preparation counter from your champion: As a Spell, deal 1+X damage to target unit, where X is the amount of sheen counters on it.
